title: Frequently asked questions — National Treasure Matsumoto Castle

facts.fact: Wheelchairs cannot enter the historic castle keep; the operator has separate provisions for outdoor areas and adapted toilets.
facts.excerpt: entry to the Tenshu by wheelchair is not possible.

facts.fact: No toilets are located inside the keep.
facts.excerpt: there are no restrooms in the Tenshu.

facts.fact: The operator forbids reposting the website photographs to blogs without separate permission; these source pages are factual research, not an image licence for this guide.
facts.excerpt: please don't post them on another homepage, a blog, or on the web.
